reviewer: Codex session, review explicitly requested by the user
scope: All positive findings from both current rubrics, across Mathlib, Tau Ceti and Lean Pool
method: Read all findings, inspected pinned target blocks and relevant APIs and supporting proofs, checked polynomial import reachability; no replacement compilation or code changes to the libraries

assessment_meaning.pursue: A source-supported, worthwhile improvement candidate that I would pursue; exact replacement uncompiled
assessment_meaning.qualified: A plausible API/refactoring idea, but the revised rubric or the complete proposal is not established
assessment_meaning.does_not_meet_rubric: I would not accept this finding under the revised rubric, for the specific reason given

findings.declaration: clm_indicator'_eq_additiveFunction / zero_mem_convexHull_of_best_approx (use of additiveFunction a S under negation and scaling by ε)
findings.rationale: The weight-to-set-function operation is genuinely linear, and the target plus Pipeline repeatedly unfold sums to prove negation, subtraction and scaling identities. A single LinearMap preserves the useful additiveFunction name and gives those actual consumers map_neg, map_sub and map_smul. This is a concrete interface improvement. Bundling finite additivity in the set argument is a separate issue; the proposed LinearMap addresses linearity in the weights.
